title: Unoverse Agent
description: An Agent: a workflow with no interface of its own, listed on the map so a conversation can reach for it (design/<org>/agents/<name>.yaml). The discovery meta plus the door: a canvas in the org, its Input Trigger, and the node whose output is the result. Every Agent is a native MCP tool. Editor guidance, not a gate: lint enforces the rules.

name.description: The file name, kebab-case. The tool's name on the wire.

description.description: What it is. One line, the listing subtitle.

whenToUse.description: Selection text, in the customer's words: what they are trying to get done.

instructions.description: What to do: the steps the Agent follows.

skills.description: The skills the Agent needs, by name.

category.description: The domain of the job, never the implementation.

message.description: What the face says while the Agent runs.

app.description: The face while it runs. Defaults to unoverse://components/agent-card; name a component only when the result deserves its own face.

workflow.description: The canvas id (wf-…), any canvas in the org.

output.description: The node whose output is the Agent's result.
